items.name: Addiction
items.description: A dependency that demands constant feeding: stimulants, gambling, or worse.
items.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

items.name: Betrayal
items.description: A personal betrayal that festers.

items.name: Blackmail
items.description: Someone possesses evidence of a secret and uses it as leverage.
items.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

items.name: Bounty
items.description: A price on the character's head.

items.name: Criminal
items.description: An active criminal record or ongoing criminal entanglement.

items.name: Debt
items.description: Money owed to someone dangerous: a Hutt, a crime lord.

items.name: Dutybound
items.description: A binding commitment to a person, group, or cause.
items.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

items.name: Family
items.description: Family members who depend on the character.

items.name: Favor
items.description: A debt of gratitude owed to someone who provided critical help.

items.name: Oath
items.description: A solemn promise that binds the character.
items.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

items.name: Obsession
items.description: A fixation on a specific goal, object, or subject.
items.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

items.name: Responsibility
items.description: A duty of care toward a group, community, or institution.

items.name: Sponsorship
items.description: Financial backing from a patron who expects results, loyalty, and compliance.

items.name: Fervor
items.description: An ideological passion that overrides practical thinking.

items.name: Adrenaline Rush
items.description: An addiction to danger itself.

items.name: Collateral Accountability
items.description: Past actions caused unintended harm to bystanders.

items.name: A Score to Settle
items.description: A grievance that demands resolution.

items.name: The Price of a Name
items.description: A family name or lineage that carries weight, and expectations.

items.name: Disgraced
items.description: A fall from a position of respect or authority.

items.name: Philanderer
items.description: A pattern of romantic entanglements that create complications.

items.name: Exiled
items.description: Banished from a homeworld, community, or organization.

items.name: Contracted
items.description: Employed under terms set by someone else.

items.name: Witness Protection
items.description: The character witnessed something they shouldn't have.

items.name: Pacifist
items.description: A deep reluctance or refusal to use violence.

items.name: Frontier Justice
items.description: A self-appointed role as enforcer of justice in lawless territory.

items.name: Base of Operation
items.description: Responsibility for maintaining a physical location: a ship, a safehouse.

items.name: Antagonist
items.description: A persistent adversary who actively works against the character's interests.

items.name: Bad Reputation
items.description: A reputation that precedes the character into every room.

items.name: Notoriety
items.description: Infamy in certain circles.

items.name: High Risk
items.description: A pattern of taking dangerous gambles: financial, physical, or strategic.

items.name: Servitude
items.description: Bound in service to another being or organization.

items.name: Under Contract
items.description: A formal employment agreement that dictates the character's professional obligations.

items.name: Crew
items.description: Responsibility for a group of people who depend on the character.

items.name: Contract
items.description: A binding agreement with a powerful party.

items.name: Failed Installation/Repair
items.description: A catastrophic professional failure. The character's competence is questioned.

items.name: Unfinished Business
items.description: Something left incomplete: a mission, a relationship, a promise.

items.name: Thrill Seeker
items.description: A compulsive need for excitement and novelty.

items.name: Vigilante
items.description: A self-appointed agent of justice operating outside legal frameworks.

items.name: Rule Breaker
items.description: A compulsive need to defy authority and break rules.

items.name: Keeper of the Faith
items.description: Custodian of a tradition, belief system, or sacred trust.

items.name: Fame
items.description: Public recognition that cuts both ways.
